description:
**CVRP Clarke–Wright savings followed by feasible relocate descent.** Use a complete symmetric matrix and hard route capacity. The savings stage starts from singleton customers and joins compatible route endpoints.

Feed the complete feasible grouping to interroute relocate. Enumerate alternate destination positions without violating capacity. Accept decreasing total depot-route distance and run another move search from the changed route set.

The procedure ends when no strict relocate improvement is found. The case combines savings construction with distinct post-construction customer redistribution.
